description: This PHP class 'OptimizerNodeVisitor' is part of the Twig templating engine, implementing AST optimization strategies for Twig templates. It manages optimization modes, processes AST nodes during traversal, and performs specific optimizations like simplifying print nodes and 'for' loops.

classes.name: OptimizerNodeVisitor
classes.description: Final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface for optimizing Twig AST nodes, managing different optimization modes, and performing node-specific transformations during AST traversal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the optimizer with a specified mode, validating the mode and triggering deprecation warnings for deprecated options.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes a node upon entering during AST traversal, applying 'for' loop optimizations if enabled.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Processes a node upon leaving during AST traversal, applying 'for' loop cleanup and optimizing print nodes.

methods.name: optimizePrintNode
methods.description: Simplifies print nodes by replacing certain expressions with static text or setting output attributes.

methods.name: enterOptimizeFor
methods.description: Handles 'for' nodes to disable loop variables and manage loop-related optimizations based on node type.

methods.name: leaveOptimizeFor
methods.description: Restores state after processing a 'for' node, cleaning up loop tracking stacks.

methods.name: addLoopToCurrent
methods.description: Marks the current loop as containing a 'with_loop' variable.

methods.name: addLoopToAll
methods.description: Marks all tracked loops as containing a 'with_loop' variable.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this visitor, set to 255.
